---
description: Grounding audit against hallucination, false memories, and unsupported claims
---

Read disciplines/09-grounding.md, then audit the current conversation's claims (or the draft under discussion):

- Every specific claim is backed by something read or run THIS SESSION, or explicitly labeled "unverified, from memory". No third option.
- Label findings: Observed (can quote it), Inferred (state the chain), or Assumed (say what would confirm it).
- No invented identifiers: API names, flags, versions, and config keys must be confirmed against installed source, --help, or docs.
- Claims about your own actions must point to a tool call in this session; if not, say "not done yet" and do it.
- If the user challenged something: re-read the primary source before responding, then either show evidence and stand firm politely, or concede plainly. Never apologize-and-agree as a reflex.
- Deliverables with factual claims also pass checklists/fact-check.md.
